import pytest

import pandas as pd
from pandas import DataFrame, concat


def test_concat_validation_refactored_from_concatenator():
    """
    Test validation behaviors refactored from _Concatenator class in PR #59141.
    
    This test ensures that parameter validation for join and sort parameters
    works correctly after the refactoring that made concat not stateful by
    removing the _Concatenator class and inlining validation logic.
    """
    df1 = DataFrame({"A": [1, 2]})
    df2 = DataFrame({"A": [3, 4]})
    
    # Test that valid join values work correctly
    result_outer = concat([df1, df2], join="outer")
    result_inner = concat([df1, df2], join="inner")
    
    # Test that invalid join values raise ValueError with correct message
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Only can inner.*outer"):
        concat([df1, df2], join="invalid_join")
    
    # Test that valid sort values work correctly
    result_false = concat([df1, df2], sort=False)
    result_true = concat([df1, df2], sort=True)
    
    # Test that invalid sort values raise ValueError with correct message
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="The 'sort' keyword only accepts boolean values"):
        concat([df1, df2], sort="invalid_sort")
    
    # Test that empty input raises ValueError with correct message
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="No objects to concatenate"):
        concat([])


def test_concat_single_object_rejection():
    """
    Test that single pandas objects are properly rejected (PR #59141 validation change).
    
    This ensures that the validation logic for rejecting single Series/DataFrame
    objects was properly moved from _Concatenator to main concat function.
    """
    df = DataFrame({"A": [1, 2]})
    series = pd.Series([1, 2])
    
    # Test that single DataFrame is rejected
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="first argument must be an iterable"):
        concat(df)
        
    # Test that single Series is rejected  
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="first argument must be an iterable"):
        concat(series)
    
    # Test that lists work correctly
    result1 = concat([df, df])
    assert isinstance(result1, DataFrame)
    
    result2 = concat([series, series])
    assert isinstance(result2, pd.Series)
